issues.detail: SI reports C10H13O5 [M+H]+ but calculated 231.0757; neutral graph C10H12O5 requires [M+H]+ 213.0757. Reported mass appears digit transposition.
SI S28 calculated 382.2103 but found 382.2005; retained source discrepancy, graph not altered.
CoA precursors, proposed intermediates I-IV and model 9a/10a are hypothetical mechanism drawings, excluded from isolated preparation network.
